messages.text: Hi there. I see you're looking at the Bitfortun BS-1. Are you weighing it up as a first miner, or comparing it against something else? I'm happy to go through the numbers with you, or help with anything else you need.
I just asking if I have completed bolt to redeem miner so that mienr will send me free of cost or something will pay?

I can't find anything on our side about a Bolt redeem offer, and no order or credit is tied to your email. So I can't confirm a free miner from us. As things stand, the BS-1 would be a normal purchase at the listed price.

Where did you see the Bolt offer? Was it in an app, an email, or a message? If someone is asking you to pay a fee or share card details to claim a free miner, please be careful. That's a common scam.
